author: /root/corpus_inventory
implementation_scope: Literal unkeyed positional [$this, privateLocalMethod] passed to the matching explicitly callable parameter of an exact same-class private nonstatic helper whose parameter uses prove direct invocation. Qualified call edge belongs to the actual caller; no new global root.

review_changes_required_and_resolved.finding: Overridable callback could bind a base declaration although receiver dispatch selects a subclass override.
review_changes_required_and_resolved.resolution: Callback target must itself be a private method declared in this class.

review_changes_required_and_resolved.finding: First-class callable creation was treated as direct invocation.
review_changes_required_and_resolved.caveat: Contract exclusion, not a source-unused label: construction or callable validation may require target existence.

review_changes_required_and_resolved.finding: Dynamic local mutation can rebind a parameter without explicit identifier assignment.
review_changes_required_and_resolved.resolution: Scope-mutation builtins including imported aliases, variable variables, include/require and unknown dynamic calls reject proof.
review_changes_required_and_resolved.caveat: Contract exclusion, not a new source-unused claim.

independent_verification.author_reported_regressions: 126 combined new/audit/existing PHP/core/benchmark tests passed; reviewer independently reran final39 focused controls.

fixture_results.notes: Dead caller and its callback, unused sibling, other-class method and two unused imports remain findings. Both grep modes exercised by focused full-scan controls.

primary_references.supports: Creates a Closure rather than normal invocation.
Imports into current symbol table and overwrites colliding variables by default.

limits: Scope abstentions do not declare unsupported callbacks dead.
